name: compass_opposite
description: Produce the opposite cardinal compass direction, with matched control repeating the given direction.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
directions='north east south west'.split();items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 d=i%4;name=random.choice(['Ada','Ben','Cara','Dan','Eva'])
 prefix=f'{name} is facing {directions[d]}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'The opposite direction is', 'answer':' '+directions[(d+2)%4]})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+f'The direction {name} is facing is', 'answer':' '+directions[d]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
